synonyms: I Was Taken in by a Fallen Noble House, so I'll Repay Their Kindness by Helping Them Rise Again
I Was Taken in by a Fallen Noble House, so I'll Repay Their Kindness by Helping Them Rise Again
Datsuraku Shita Kizokuke ni Hirowaretanode Ongaeshi de Hukkou Sasemasu
synopsis: Leon, a former abandoned child taken in by a fallen noble family ruined by deceitful aristocrats, determined to repay the love and kindness shown to him by his new family, vows to restore their household. Using his talent for magic, he enrolls in a magic academy with the goal of becoming a great mage. While he is blessed with like-minded friends, worthy rivals, and dependable mentors, he also faces many formidable figures—such as arrogant nobles who abuse their status, and a suspicious second prince of the kingdom hiding something beneath the surface. Academy life turns out to be far more chaotic and eventful than he ever imagined! A heartfelt tale of a kind-hearted boy rising through the ranks with the power he’s honed—this full-fledged magical academy fantasy novel finally gets its long-awaited manga adaptation!

title: Yamikin Ushijima-kun
synopsis: In recent years, Japan has become the shining light of Asia, with its noteworthy achievements in the fields of Science and Technology, Medicine and the like. But while there are a great number of rich and successful Japanese people, there are even more who're engaged in a furious struggle simply to earn their day-to-day living expenses -- all the while battling dangerous and money-consuming addictions such as gambling and alcoholism. What will these people do when they require the cash to feed the never-ending desires that are part and parcel of being human? How miserable and dangerous might their lives become if they fall into traps set by black market money-lenders to ensnare just such weak-willed individuals? Note: Won the 56th Shogakukan Manga Award for general manga in 2011. And the 23rd Japan Media Arts Festival Social Impact Award in 2020.

synopsis: This fantasy story conveys the bond between a beast tamer and the strongest cat girl starting from their first meeting! Rein, a beast tamer who fights with the help of animals, has been a member of the hero's party for the longest time. However, unbeknownst to him, he was dragging down his teammates because he had no other abilities. "You have no worth outside of taming animals. You're fired." With that, he was kicked out of the party. At that moment, Rein no longer wanted anything to do with saving the world and decided to live for himself. Once he set out to become an adventurer, he met a girl from the cat tribe, a tribe believed to be part of the superior race. Meanwhile, the hero's party was unaware they were only able to fight the Demon King's army all along because of Rein's power... This story is about how the oppressed beast tamer met his destined comrades and formed bonds with them all. (Source: Manga UP!)
